title: File Formats
description: Common file formats identified by extension and category.

results.description: The default word-processing format used by Microsoft Word.

results.description: The default spreadsheet format used by Microsoft Excel.

results.description: The default presentation format used by Microsoft PowerPoint.

results.description: A lossy audio format designed as a successor to MP3.

results.description: An open, patent-free lossy audio container and format.

results.description: A widely used multimedia container for video and audio.

results.description: A multimedia container format introduced by Microsoft.
